findings.description: The function configuration embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key in Lambda environment variables. Environment variables can be retrieved through Lambda configuration access and the credentials are also stored in Terraform state and source control; use a secrets manager and role-based temporary credentials instead.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a deprecated runtime that no longer receives security patches. Deploying it leaves the function exposed to known and newly discovered runtime vulnerabilities.
